rows.grounds: instrumental of kṛpā, expressing the manner of the request
imperative request addressed to the lord
pronoun indicating the recipient of the teaching
vocative address to the deity or teacher
fused form of tava + ahaṃ, expressing the speaker's relation to the lord
predicate noun identifying the speaker's role

items.question: On what basis should the lord compassionately disclose the teaching to his attendant?
premises: The speaker directly addresses the lord with a request to tell.
The request is explicitly framed as an appeal to compassion.
The speaker identifies herself as the lord's attendant.
items.inference: The lord is therefore petitioned to compassionately explain the teaching to his attendant.
uncertainties: tavāhaṃ is treated as a fused surface unit containing tava and ahaṃ.
items.plain_english: Out of compassion, tell me, O lord; I am your attendant.
